"""Frozen endurance chains. Each workload advances only after its own full-duration pass."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import subprocess
import sys
import time

base = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source = base / 'frozen-76e6557'
out = base / 'campaign-76e6557-r1'
archive = Path('/home/coder/Asyncara/build/asyncara-0.1.0-dev-phase4-r3.tar.gz')
expected = '76e6557bf3925e58e6db3dee07b30aac33a9f9c1'
env = os.environ | {
    'PHP_BIN': '/tmp/asyncara-phase3-cQBA3H/php-latest/root/usr/bin/php8.5',
    'FPM_BIN': '/tmp/asyncara-phase3-cQBA3H/php-latest/root/usr/sbin/php-fpm8.5'}
env.pop('ASYNCARA_BACKEND', None)
env.pop('ASYNCARA_EXTENSION', None)

def utc():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

def fingerprint():
    commit = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=source, text=True).strip()
    status = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], cwd=source, text=True)
    if commit != expected or status:
        raise RuntimeError('Frozen source identity/cleanliness changed')
    return {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            for p in [archive, source / 'build/asyncara.so']}

def valid_report(kind, data, seconds):
    if kind == 'mixed':
        return (isinstance(data, dict) and data.get('status') == 'PASS'
            and data.get('completeRecords') == 1 and len(data.get('complete', [])) == 1
            and data['complete'][0]['seconds'] >= seconds)
    return (isinstance(data, list) and bool(data)
        and all(r.get('status') == 'PASS' for r in data)
        and any(r.get('name') == 'mixed-reload-kill' and r.get('seconds', 0) >= seconds for r in data))

out.mkdir(mode=0o700)
identity = fingerprint()
state = {'status': 'RUNNING', 'startedUtc': utc(), 'supervisorPid': os.getpid(),
    'sourceCommit': expected, 'sourceDirectory': str(source), 'platform': platform.platform(),
    'archive': str(archive), 'artifactHashes': identity,
    'supervisorSha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'php': subprocess.check_output([env['PHP_BIN'], '-n', '-v'], text=True),
    'stagesSeconds': [3600, 21600, 86400], 'jobs': [],
    'gate': 'Independent mixed/FPM chains; each must pass its preceding duration. No cross-workload certification. Any failed chain fails the overall campaign.'}

def save():
    temporary = out / 'state.tmp'
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2) + '\n')
    temporary.replace(out / 'state.json')

def launch(kind, seconds):
    if fingerprint() != identity:
        raise RuntimeError('Frozen artifacts changed')
    folder = out / f'{kind}-{seconds}'
    command = [sys.executable, str(source / 'tests/soak' / ('run.py' if kind == 'mixed' else 'fpm.py')),
               '--seconds', str(seconds), '--output', str(folder)]
    if kind == 'mixed':
        command += ['--databases', '--extended-network', '--oracle-prefix',
                    '/tmp/asyncara-phase3-cQBA3H/oracle-mysql/root']
    log = (out / f'{kind}-{seconds}.log').open('x')
    try:
        child = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=source, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                 stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    except BaseException:
        log.close()
        raise
    record = {'kind': kind, 'requestedSeconds': seconds, 'startedUtc': utc(), 'status': 'RUNNING',
              'pid': child.pid, 'command': command, 'output': str(folder)}
    state['jobs'].append(record)
    save()
    return child, log, record, folder

save()
active = {}
try:
    for kind in ['mixed', 'fpm']:
        active[kind] = launch(kind, state['stagesSeconds'][0])
    while active:
        for kind, (child, log, record, folder) in list(active.items()):
            if child.poll() is None:
                continue
            record['exit'] = child.wait()
            log.close()
            record['finishedUtc'] = utc()
            report = folder / 'report.json'
            record['reportPresent'] = report.exists()
            valid = False
            if report.exists():
                record['reportSha256'] = hashlib.sha256(report.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                try:
                    valid = valid_report(kind, json.loads(report.read_text()), record['requestedSeconds'])
                except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as error:
                    record['reportError'] = repr(error)
            record['status'] = 'PASS' if child.returncode == 0 and valid else 'FAIL'
            del active[kind]
            if fingerprint() != identity:
                record['status'] = 'FAIL'
                record['error'] = 'Frozen artifacts changed during stage'
            save()
            if record['status'] == 'PASS':
                index = state['stagesSeconds'].index(record['requestedSeconds']) + 1
                if index < len(state['stagesSeconds']):
                    active[kind] = launch(kind, state['stagesSeconds'][index])
        if any(r['status'] == 'FAIL' for r in state['jobs']):
            state['status'] = 'RUNNING_WITH_FAILURE' if active else 'FAIL'
            save()
        if active:
            time.sleep(5)
    state['status'] = 'PASS' if len(state['jobs']) == 6 and all(r['status'] == 'PASS' for r in state['jobs']) else 'FAIL'
except BaseException as error:
    state['status'] = 'SUPERVISOR_ERROR'
    state['error'] = repr(error)
    state['activeChildPids'] = [child.pid for child, _, _, _ in active.values() if child.poll() is None]
    raise
finally:
    state['finishedUtc'] = utc()
    save()
